description: Port Hope Watch: NASA from space, phone on the ground. Loud inside, quiet outside = contained. Using a phone magnetometer and one formula  — Δ = (Reading − 56) × 1000 — to track trends at Port Hope: Toronto 53.5 clean, Wesleyville 54.1 clean,  Vault 60.9 loud (4900 nT).  No lab. No $10,000 sensor.  Just a phone, one formula, 3 minutes.
summary:
Port Hope, Ontario has a uranium / radium legacy from the 1930s-80s. 1.2M m³ of contaminated soil is now gathered into one engineered mound — the LTWMF — capped and monitored for 500+ years.

Port Hope Watch lets anyone verify containment with a phone. No lab. No expensive sensor.

What is changing, where, how much, is it significant?
- WHAT: Magnetic field anomaly + mound land-cover + vegetation around mound
- WHERE: Port Hope LTWMF, Q 43.9512N 78.2915W → W 43.9015N 78.3452W, 8.44km vector, peak at 4.2km = Vault center
- HOW MUCH: Vault 60.9 µT vs 56 µT background = 4.9 µT = 4900 nT = 3.92 kA/m². Loud inside, quiet outside.
- SIGNIFICANT? Yes. >100 nT = noisy threshold. 4900 nT is 49x threshold, 5x typical landfill anomaly (~1000 nT). Outside zones are -1900 to 0 nT = clean. Contained and measurable.

NASA shows the trend from space. Phone shows the trend on the ground. Together they prove the same thing.
details:
HOW IT WORKS:

1. Phone Check - 3 min with Physics Toolbox.

2. Calculate Δ = (Reading - Baseline) x 1000, baseline 56 µT.

3. Decide - 0 to ±100 Clean, 100-500 Noisy, ~4900 Vault Center.

4. Map - Q to W 8.44 km, 201.7° SSW, 6 stations, peak at 4.2 km; secondary Q to T 94.46 km.

5. Log - weekly/monthly CSV hash.

6. Hand off - Library Map + Dashboard + 1-page guide.

TOOLS: Phone magnetometer, LTWMF Verification Dashboard, LTWMF Library Map, Master File SHA8 90109b50, NASA Giovanni, Earthdata, Landsat, POWER.

GOALS: 3-min phone-only verification; time-series space 1984-2025 + ground 2026-forward; hand to community, schools, Waterkeeper.

REPLICATION - Where This Fits Beyond Port Hope

ON EARTH: Elliot Lake, Uranium City, Navajo Nation, landfills, mine tailings, brownfields.

OFF EARTH: Moon Base / Mars handheld verification analog.

WHERE IT FITS: On Earth and off Earth.

SIGNIFICANCE: A 500-year problem.

OPPORTUNITIES: Schools, First Nations/community monitors, Waterkeepers, municipalities.

ADDITIONAL USES: Schools, First Nations/community monitors, Waterkeepers, municipalities, FOI + open data 4.32M records, climate + vegetation Landsat/MODIS, other contaminants.

One method. Any place. On Earth or off it.

AI USE: Meta AI + Microsoft Copilot for drafting, dedup, dashboard prototype. All science claims checked against readings + NASA / official sources. AI images/video watermarked/labeled. AI code acknowledged. No under-18 photos/voices. Page in English. No NASA branding.

SOURCES: NASA Earthdata, Giovanni, POWER, AppEEARS, USGS Landsat, ESA Swarm, NOAA WMM, NOAA EMAG2v3, PHAI, OPG, Port Hope, CNL, Physics Toolbox, Dashboard, Library Map, Python/ReportLab

FIELD PROOF: Toronto 53.5 µT Δ 0 Clean • Wesleyville 54.1 µT Δ -1900 Clean • Quinlan 56.2 µT Δ 200 Noisy — Sealed 99.9% • Vault 60.9 µT Δ 4900 Loud — Contained. Vector Q→W 8.44km 201.7° SSW, peak at 4.2km = Vault center.
